name: Prism Launcher
what_it_is: An open-source Minecraft launcher that manages multiple instances, accounts, modpacks and mods, forked from MultiMC.
pricing: Free; the project accepts donations and publishes under open-source licenses.
key_features: One-click mod loader install (Forge, Fabric, Quilt, LiteLoader)
Modpacks from CurseForge, Modrinth, Technic, FTB
Per-mod install from CurseForge and Modrinth
notable: Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft
Forked from MultiMC over redistribution concerns

facts.fact: Prism Launcher is an open-source Minecraft launcher that manages multiple instances, accounts and mods.
It installs mod loaders such as Forge, Fabric, Quilt and LiteLoader in one click and installs modpacks from CurseForge, Modrinth, Technic, FTB and FTB Legacy.
The project was forked from MultiMC over packaging and redistribution concerns and states it is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
